entities.summary: Franz Koritschoner was an Austrian communist politician. Born in Vienna, Koritschoner was a leading figure of the Communist Party of Austria (KPÖ), and a member of its Central Committee until 1928. He translated the works of Lenin and edited the central party organ Die Rote Fahne.
